editionData.description: Global headlines: Southeast Asian leaders kick-start summit, with South China Sea and energy on agenda (President Donald Trump is set to land in Manila on Tuesday evening — a fact that had ASEAN attendees buzzing and protesters at the ready); Iran targets Bahrain twice after months of quiet, claiming retaliation against U.S. (The strikes come amid concern about escalation, as President Donald Trump has turned away from diplomacy); and Italy fines Meta $887M for accessing Android users’ photos (Meta's Facebook app accessed users’ photos and videos on Android devices without “obtaining specific consent,” Italian authorities said). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: How to make almost anything (pub.cba.mit.edu: How to make almost anything); Universal XSS in uBlock Origin from website-driven element picker (One-click UXSS issue with uBlock Origin on Firefox through element picker); and Qwen4-Max (Qwen offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search...). Product Hunt features Punchcutter (Turn a sentence or your handwriting into a real font family), Zode (The fastest, cheapest cloud VMs for agents), and Cal.com v7 (Cal.com now has events, discover, an assistant + more).
editionData.author: Sony Mathew

headlines.title: Wartime Kyiv is turning to a new comfort food: Bagels
headlines.summary: Models and diplomats flock to this cafe, where the owner, a veteran, says baking has given him a new mission after he was injured in the conflict with Russia.

headlines.title: At least 11 killed in blaze on Thailand’s Phuket island
headlines.summary: Authorities are investigating the cause of the fire, which also injured 16, but have ruled out arson.

headlines.title: Widow of Haiti’s slain leader Moise to contest presidential vote
headlines.summary: Martine Moise is one of ​33 registered candidates running in Haiti's first presidential election in a decade.

headlines.title: After a nationwide ground stop, US faces aviation infrastructure questions
headlines.summary: Trump has requested $50bn for upgrades, but Democratic lawmakers are asking for transparency before spending more.

headlines.summary: Congress recently gave the Department of Transportation $12.5 billion to upgrade the aging air traffic control system. President Trump wants more.

headlines.title: Far from home. Voyager 1 is now farther than anything man has sent into space
headlines.summary: NASA's Voyager 1, which is the furthest man-made object from Earth, is set to reach a new milestone this week. On Wednesday, the probe will be roughly 16 billion miles from Earth.

headlines.title: Who makes Sydney Sweeney's American Eagle jeans — and under what conditions?
headlines.summary: Sydney Sweeney has great jeans, American Eagle Outfitters tells us. But who made them? And what are working conditions like in the garment factories of Pakistan and Bangladesh?

headlines.title: New Orleans port sues owners of tanker involved in Mississippi crash
headlines.summary: Officials are seeking at least $1 million in damages from the owners of the tanker that hit a cruise ship last week. The incident was dubbed "the miracle on the Mississippi" after no one was killed.

headlines.title: Laws limiting coal miners' exposure to toxic dust are in danger of being rolled back
headlines.summary: Coal miners who are exposed to silica dust are at a higher risk of black lung disease. Despite decades of advocacy, new efforts to regulate the toxic dust are under threat.

headlines.title: Economic woes fuel public ire
headlines.summary: A wave of protests has swept across Europe in recent months, reflecting growing public frustration over the cost of living, public services and government policies, experts say.

headlines.title: US international student enrollment falls amid visa restrictions, rising costs
headlines.summary: International student enrollment in the United States continued to decline this fall, with colleges and universities citing visa restrictions, rising costs and growing competition from other countries as factors discouraging students from pursuing a US education.

headlines.title: China highlights market opportunities for investors
headlines.summary: China welcomes greater investment from European companies and remains committed to resolving trade differences with the European Union through dialogue, a senior Chinese official said in Brussels on Friday.

headlines.title: US transportation secretary refuses to apologize for FAA's nationwide ground stop
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON -- US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy on Sunday refused to apologize for Federal Aviation Administration (FAA)'s nationwide ground stop that lasted for hours on Friday, which disrupted over 10,000 flights, with the impact continuing throughout the weekend.

headlines.title: Iran says drones hit US radar system in Bahrain
headlines.summary: TEHRAN — Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Sunday that its aerospace force had targeted US air defense radar station in Bahrain in a drone attack in the preceding hours.

headlines.title: Congress MP Bimol Akoijam to contest 2027 Manipur assembly polls
headlines.summary: Congress MP Bimol Akoijam to contest 2027 Manipur polls from Keisamthong, amid controversy over sexual harassment allegations and party strategy.

headlines.title: Voting underway for final phase of panchayat polls in Rajasthan
headlines.summary: Voting underway for final phase of Rajasthan panchayat polls across 3,747 gram panchayats, with 1.05 crore voters at 11,905 stations.

headlines.title: Odisha orders early evacuation of vulnerable areas as cyclone threat looms
headlines.summary: Odisha orders early evacuations as a deep depression strengthens into a very severe cyclonic storm, prompting precautionary measures ahead of heavy rainfall and rough sea conditions.

hackerNews.summary: When Salon launched in 1995, the web was still finding its voice. One of the first major publications born on the internet, Salon helped define a new kind of digital journalism, bringing together politics, culture, criticism, and ideas for a generation of online readers. After 31 years, Salon has announced that it is ceasing publication.
